en.joke: My social media feed is just ads for things I just looked at in real life.
en.explanation: This deadpan observation highlights the intrusive, yet mundane, reality of targeted advertising, which is relatable modern anti-humor.

people.name: David Copperfield (illusionist)
people.extract: David Seth Kotkin, known professionally as David Copperfield, is an American stage magician and illusionist described by Forbes as the most commercially successful magician in history.
highlights: Most commercially successful magician in history.

people.name: Mike Reynolds (Australian politician)
people.extract: Michael Francis Reynolds is an Australian politician. He was a Labor member of the Legislative Assembly of Queensland from 1998 to 2009, representing the district of Townsville. He served as Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Queensland from 2006 to 2009.
highlights: Labor member, Legislative Assembly of Queensland (1998-2009).

people.name: Kyla Pratt
people.extract: Kyla Alissa Pratt is an American actress. She is best known for providing the voice of Penny Proud in the first Disney Channel animated series, The Proud Family, its 2005 film adaptation and its revival The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder, and for portraying Breanna Latrice Barnes in UPN's One on One. She is also known for playing Maya Dolittle in the Dr. Dolittle franchise reboot from 1998 to 2009. From 2012 to 2014, she appeared in the series Let's Stay Together. She was formerly a part of VH1's Black Ink Crew: Compton and the cast of Call Me Kat on Fox.
highlights: Voice of Penny Proud in The Proud Family.
Portrayed Breanna Barnes in UPN's One on One.
Played Maya Dolittle in the Dr. Dolittle franchise.
